summary: Screen fade with genuinely zero setup: it creates its own overlay canvas if you do not give it one.
overview: Call FadeManager.Instance.FadeOut from anywhere. If no overlay Image is assigned it builds its own full-screen Canvas and Image on first use, at a high sorting order so it draws over everything — so there is nothing to wire in the scene at all.
useCases: Fading out before a scene load and back in after.
Covering a moment of heavy loading.

params.tuning: Assign one only when it needs to sit at a particular place in your canvas order. Otherwise let it build its own.
Black is conventional; white reads as a flash, which suits a different kind of moment.

gotchas.title: The auto-created overlay blocks raycasts while opaque
gotchas.body: That is usually what you want during a transition, and a problem if you fade out and never fade back in.
